static_traits.name: Lin Ruian
static_traits.social_status: Has one close friend but has not confided negative thoughts to them; recently avoids socializing
static_traits.medical_history: No obvious physical illness; no similar psychological problems before; has not received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, relatively cooperative, low tone, prone to self-deprecation and repeated rumination

basic_info.main_problem: I feel I dyed my red hair the wrong color, which makes me believe I am stupid and incompetent; these feelings and negative thoughts are triggered every time I look in the mirror or hear comments about my hair color.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize these negative thoughts about my own intelligence have affected my self-esteem and daily functioning, so I am seeking counseling; I hope to view this matter from a different perspective, move beyond the distress, and stop letting it control my life.

special_situations.event: Looking in the mirror and seeing the hair-dye result differs from expectations
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is an obvious mistake in appearance, it means I am overall very stupid and very incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly giving oneself negative labels, trying to fix the dyeing at home oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am so stupid; I cannot even get my hair color right

special_situations.event: 收到他人对发色的评论
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others comment on my hair color, it means they are negating or mocking me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids socializing and does not confide in friends, to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 大家都觉得我是个笑话

special_situations.event: Needing to make decisions or take on tasks at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot even choose a hair color well, I cannot handle larger tasks
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Hesitating at work, reducing attempts to avoid 'failing' again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot trust my own ability to do bigger things

special_situations.event: At night, repeatedly recalls the hair-dyeing experience and details of the 'mistake'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I keep examining this mistake, it can prove I will always fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ruminating and ignoring positive evidence or other demonstrations of ability

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted, to confirm his own abilities and value
core_conflict.fear: Fears being ridiculed and negated by others, exposing his own 'incompetence' and flaws
defense_goal: Reduces the threat of external evaluation through self-deprecation and avoiding socializing
Maintains caution and self-doubt to avoid taking on greater risks and failure

object_relations.object_representation: The picky other, with judgment and ridicule

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When counseling or others mention appearance mistakes, others' opinions, or ask him to examine larger tasks
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to believe that others (including the counselor) are judging or looking down on him (transference: viewing others as critics)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use a gentle, validating tone; avoid judgment and labeling; use more open-ended questions and short sentences; allow pauses and emotion naming, helping them distinguish facts from speculation.

manifestations: Has not expressed vulnerability and distress to close friends; feels shame
Generalizing one appearance mistake to 'everything I do will go wrong'
Viewing overall ability through a failure self-schema

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Withdrawing in social settings, worried about being seen and judged
In counseling, repeatedly focuses on mistakes, finding it hard to accept a more balanced perspective but willing to try

positive_force: Proactively seeking help and willing to try alternative perspectives
Having some problem-solving behavior (having tried to fix dyeing at home)
Has a close friend to confide in (potential support resource)
Able to express inner experiences clearly, with clear motivation for counseling
negative_force: A cognitive style of self-labeling and overgeneralization
Caring excessively about others' opinions and engaging in mind-reading speculation
Rumination and shame lead to disrupted sleep and eating
Social avoidance and self-doubt worsen impairment in work functioning
Reliance on external evaluation; prone to equating a single mistake with overall ability

target_behavior.behavior: Self-derogatory negative self-talk (such as 'I am stupid / I am a failure')
antecedent: Looking in the mirror and seeing the dyed hair differs from expectations
回想在沙龙的染发经历
听到他人对外观的评论
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizes a single appearance mistake and overgeneralizes it into overall incompetence, introjecting external evaluations as judgments of self-worth
target_behavior.function: Avoids further attempts and external evaluation through self-punishment and self-negation, escaping shame and anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Markedly decreased self-esteem, low mood and increased rumination, impaired work performance

antecedent: 被邀请外出或社交互动
Thinking that others will see one's hair color
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being laughed at and negated (mind-reading speculation), strong sense of shame
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential negative evaluation and uncomfortable emotions, gaining a short-term sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Social contact decreases; loneliness and negative self-image intensify

target_behavior.behavior: Disturbed sleep and eating rhythms (insomnia/oversleeping, decreased appetite)
antecedent: 夜间躺床时反刍染发错误
target_behavior.core_reason: Persistent negative automatic thoughts and rumination trigger changes in physiological arousal and emotional dysregulation
target_behavior.function: Partly a passive avoidance or dysregulated reaction to pain (such as excessive sleep to temporarily reduce discomfort)
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in physical stamina and focus, further affecting work and emotional stability
